translations.web: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.
translations.bsb: All these cities were fortified with high walls and gates and bars, and there were many more unwalled villages.
translations.kjv: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.
translations.asv: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars; besides the unwalled towns a great many.
